 participant A as Capsule run A
 participant L as network.lock
 participant S as ipam.json
 participant B as Capsule run B
 A->>L: Acquire exclusive lock
 B->>L: Request lock and wait
 A->>S: Read leases and reserve first free IP

 A->>L: Release lock
 L-->>B: Lock acquired
 B->>S: Read updated leases
 B->>S: Reserve a different IP and replace state
 B->>L: Release lock
 Note over A,B: Release uses the same lock after network cleanup",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
